_note: ext-49 Trika places and teaching circles (2026-10-31). Each place read on its official site that day; coordinates from OSM (Nominatim) for published addresses only.

places.name: Tantra Illuminated (Christopher Hareesh Wallis), online and Portugal
places.city: Online; retreats in Portugal and abroad
places.description: Christopher Wallis’s online school of classical Tantra (founded 2019): weekly live teaching, textual courses such as the Spanda-kārikā, and in-person retreats.

places.name: Tantravimarśa (Alka Tyagi), online and India
places.description: Alka Tyagi’s online courses on Trika scriptures (Pratyabhijñāhṛdayam on Wednesdays in 2026) plus workshops and retreats joining text study with practice.

places.name: The Movement Center (Swami Chetanananda), Oregon
places.description: Swami Chetanananda’s community, formerly the Nityananda Institute; he sits with students five nights a week in Gold Beach and teaches the Śiva Sūtras online (e-TMC Academy).

places.name: The Ashram Mount Eliza (Swami Shankarananda)
places.description: Residential ashram (est. 1996) in the Nityananda–Muktananda line, formerly the Shiva Ashram; weekly satsang, meditation, Self-inquiry groups and study of Kashmir Śaivism.

places.name: Jaya Kula (Shambhavi Sarasvati), Portland
places.description: Nonprofit community practising Trika Shaivism and Dzogchen under Shambhavi Sarasvati; satsang, retreats and livestreamed teachings from Matrika House.

places.name: Heart of Consciousness (Swami Khecaranatha): Nityakash, Maui and Rudrakash, Richmond
places.description: Swami Khecaranatha’s community in the Nityananda–Rudi line: Nityakash retreat centre on Maui (since 2020) and Rudrakash in Richmond, California, with weekly eyes-open meditation.

places.name: Blue Throat Yoga (Paul Muller-Ortega)
places.description: School of meditation and study founded in 2006 by Paul Muller-Ortega on the nondual Śākta-Śaiva teaching of Abhinavagupta; Neelakantha Meditation, retreats and a study curriculum.

places.name: Daniel Odier: seminars in Kashmir Shaiva Tantra (Europe)
places.city: Itinerant: Switzerland, France, Germany, Italy, Spain
places.description: Weekend workshops and residential seminars on the Vijñāna Bhairava and Kaula practices, which he says he received from the yoginī Lalitā Devī; no fixed centre.

places.name: Parabhairavayoga (Gabriel Pradīpaka)
places.description: Foundation for Gabriel Pradīpaka’s Trika teaching (founded 2016), with appointed teachers in several countries and the multilingual Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism site.

places.name: Trika School of Tantra / Shivashaktivigyan (Amitabh Ji), Bengaluru
places.coord_precision: suburb (Indiranagar; street address on the site)
places.description: Amitabh Ji’s school teaching Trika (Kashmir Shaivism) through meditation, Vijñāna Bhairava practice, retreats, yatras and shaktipat, in person and online.

places.name: Kashmir Shaivism School of Yoga, Dharamsala
places.description: Yoga teacher-training school founded by Kashmiri yogacharyas; besides asana courses it runs programmes solely on Kashmir Śaivism (Spanda, Vijñāna Bhairava), in person and online.
